The '''''Diligence''''' was an [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|''Inexpugnable''-class tactical command ship]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].

==History==
The vessel was commanded by then-[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dallan Morvis]].

Thousands of years later, the ship was mentioned by [[Arkadia Calimondra]]. It also became the namesake of [[Jarrow Rusher]]'s [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|ship]].
